targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_date(year_month || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS time, quality_score, valid_record_rate FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pq.partition_id) pq.*, p.year_month
  FROM dq.partition_quality pq JOIN dq.pipeline_runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN dq.dataset_partitions p USING (partition_id) WHERE p.service='yellow'
  ORDER BY pq.partition_id, r.started_at DESC) x ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_date(year_month || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS time, rows_total AS rows, quarantined_records AS quarantined, warning_only_records AS warning_only FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pq.partition_id) pq.*, p.year_month
  FROM dq.partition_quality pq JOIN dq.pipeline_runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN dq.dataset_partitions p USING (partition_id) WHERE p.service='yellow'
  ORDER BY pq.partition_id, r.started_at DESC) x ORDER BY 1

SELECT rr.partition_id, rr.rule_id, rr.severity, rr.failed_rows, round((100*rr.failure_rate)::numeric, 4) AS failure_pct
                  FROM dq.rule_results rr JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pq.partition_id) pq.*, p.year_month
  FROM dq.partition_quality pq JOIN dq.pipeline_runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN dq.dataset_partitions p USING (partition_id) WHERE p.service='yellow'
  ORDER BY pq.partition_id, r.started_at DESC) l USING (run_id, partition_id)
                  WHERE rr.failed_rows > 0 ORDER BY rr.partition_id, rr.failed_rows DESC

SELECT to_date(l.year_month || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS time, rr.columns AS metric,
                         100*sum(rr.failed_rows)::float/max(rr.records_checked) AS value
                  FROM dq.rule_results rr JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pq.partition_id) pq.*, p.year_month
  FROM dq.partition_quality pq JOIN dq.pipeline_runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN dq.dataset_partitions p USING (partition_id) WHERE p.service='yellow'
  ORDER BY pq.partition_id, r.started_at DESC) l USING (run_id, partition_id)
                  WHERE rr.failed_rows > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.partition_id, d.reference_partition_id AS reference, d.column_name, d.metric,
                         round(d.value::numeric, 4) AS value, d.threshold, d.status
                  FROM dq.drift_results d JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pq.partition_id) pq.*, p.year_month
  FROM dq.partition_quality pq JOIN dq.pipeline_runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN dq.dataset_partitions p USING (partition_id) WHERE p.service='yellow'
  ORDER BY pq.partition_id, r.started_at DESC) l USING (run_id, partition_id)
                  WHERE d.status IN ('alert','warn') ORDER BY d.partition_id, d.status, d.column_name

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_date(year_month || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS time, source_lag_days FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pq.partition_id) pq.*, p.year_month
  FROM dq.partition_quality pq JOIN dq.pipeline_runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN dq.dataset_partitions p USING (partition_id) WHERE p.service='yellow'
  ORDER BY pq.partition_id, r.started_at DESC) x ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.partition_id, s.check_name, s.column_name, s.severity, s.detail
                 FROM dq.schema_checks s JOIN dq.dataset_partitions p USING (partition_id)
                 WHERE p.service='yellow' ORDER BY s.checked_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT a.partition_id, a.method, a.anomalies, round((100*a.anomaly_rate)::numeric, 3) AS rate_pct,
                         round(a.runtime_s::numeric, 2) AS runtime_s
                  FROM dq.anomaly_results a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (pq.partition_id) pq.*, p.year_month
  FROM dq.partition_quality pq JOIN dq.pipeline_runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN dq.dataset_partitions p USING (partition_id) WHERE p.service='yellow'
  ORDER BY pq.partition_id, r.started_at DESC) l USING (run_id, partition_id) ORDER BY 1, 2
